decision.explanation: The question asks for the construction dates of 'Church of Our Lady of the Rosary'. The sources identify four distinct churches with this name in different locations, each with a specific date: 1) Alcamo, Italy has conflicting sources citing founding years 1660 (D1, D2) and 1750 (D3); both are retained as distinct valid referents/claims found in the text. 2) Goa, India was built in 1544–1547 (D4). 3) Asmara, Eritrea was built in 1923 (D5). Rejected candidates include 1587 (date of friars in a different church), 1510 (conquest date), 1866 (date of friary repurposing), 1544/1547 (partial range), and 1927/1928 (dates associated with a different entity, Our Lady of the Rosary Cathedral in San Bernardino, mentioned only in metadata fragments).
